I am a fifth-year PhD candidate in mathematics at Dartmouth College (currently on the job market), originally from Dallas, Texas. My research focuses on developing fast, structure-exploiting and structure-preserving methods for large-scale inverse problems and uncertainty quantification in scientific computing. My advisor is [Anne Gelb](https://math.dartmouth.edu/~annegelb/).

I am always open to discussions about my research or related topics. Please do not hesitate to reach out at [jonathan.t.lindbloom.gr@dartmouth.edu](mailto:jonathan.t.lindbloom.gr@dartmouth.edu?subject=Inquiry%20about%20your%20work).
